title: Embedded quantum computing for many-body surface reaction
summary: Predictive simulations of catalytic interfaces require correlated electronic-structure treatments that describe localized chemical transformations while retaining the influence of the extended metallic environment. We introduce QC-DFET, a quantum-computing density-functional embedding framework that maps surface-reaction active spaces to compact, environment-aware qubit Hamiltonians.
